BLUEBERRY TUMBLE - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT, art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: see LICENSE-blueberrytumble.txt.

A blueberry fell off its bush at the top of the mountain and tumbles all the
way down to the valley. It rolls by itself: you only jump, on the beat of the
music. Thorn bushes, rocks, fallen logs, crevasses, rolling pine cones and icy
patches; mushrooms that bounce you high, dew drops to jump again in mid-air, a
maple leaf to glide on, snow that turns you into a big snowberry. Snowy summit,
pine forest, blueberry meadows, the valley village, then again at night,
faster. Medals at 200, 500, 1000 and 1600 m; golden blueberries for a bonus;
your best score and your attempts are kept.

Run BlueberryTumble.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

Controls                  Gamepad (SNES layout)      Keyboard
  jump, start, retry        A, Up or Start             X, Up or Enter
                            (B, X and Y jump too)      (Z, A and S too)
  hold: jump on landing     hold A                     hold X
  on a dew drop: jump again A in mid-air               X in mid-air
  gliding: rise / sink      hold A / let go            hold X / let go
  pause / resume            Select (or Start in a run) Backspace or Esc
  player 2 joins the race   pad 2: A on the title or "get ready" screen

Two players race down the same slope, each with their own pad (player 2 is a
raspberry); the panel at the end shows both scores and the winner.

F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Options: BlueberryTumble.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
The best score is saved in blueberrytumble.srm next to the exe.
